Package common.hardware.motorcontroller.sim

Interface MotorSimModel

All Known Implementing Classes:
LinearSimModel, PivotSimModel, RollerSimModel
public interface MotorSimModel
Physics for whatever a motor is driving, used only in simulation. Attach one to a motor with NAR_Motor.enableSim(model).

Everything is measured at the motor (rotor) shaft, because that is what the real motor controller's encoder reports. Each model starts at 0 rotations, like a real motor does when the robot turns on.
